templates.name: Prometheus
templates.description: Metrics collection and alerting with local time-series storage.
templates.author: upsetdev
hints: Size the volume for retention × ingest rate.
Has no authentication; keep it internal or put it behind an authenticating proxy.

templates.name: WordPress
templates.description: The WordPress site builder and blog, on a MySQL database Pyo runs.
templates.author: upsetdev
hints: Add a domain, then finish the setup at its address.
Themes, plugins and uploads (up to 64 MB) stay on its volume.
Turn on the WAF in its Firewall tab to block common attacks.

templates.name: MongoDB
templates.description: Document database, single replica, with authentication enabled.
templates.author: upsetdev
hints: Single-server deployment; replica sets are not configured.
Back up with mongodump or volume snapshots.

templates.name: Ghost
templates.description: Publishing platform for blogs and newsletters, on a MySQL database Pyo runs.
templates.author: upsetdev
hints: Needs a domain: it's the site's address. Create the admin account at /ghost.
For newsletters and sign-ups, add mail__transport=SMTP and mail__options__* variables.

templates.name: n8n
templates.description: Workflow automation: connect APIs and apps with a visual editor.
templates.author: upsetdev
hints: Add an HTTPS domain so webhooks and OAuth callbacks reach it.
The encryption key protects saved credentials; keep it if you redeploy.

fields.label: Timezone
fields.help: Used by schedule triggers, e.g. Europe/Berlin.

templates.name: Ollama
templates.description: Run open models like Llama, Qwen and Gemma behind a local HTTP API.
templates.author: upsetdev
hints: Uses an NVIDIA GPU when its cluster has one, and runs on CPU otherwise.
Pull a model with POST /api/pull before the first request. Models are kept on the volume.
Models are large: size the volume, memory and GPU memory for the ones you use.

templates.name: Open WebUI
templates.description: A chat interface for your own models, served by Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible API such as vLLM.
templates.author: upsetdev
hints: The first account to sign up becomes its admin: sign up right after deploying.
It runs on CPU; the models it talks to can use GPUs.

fields.label: Ollama address
fields.help: Your Ollama service, by its name in this project.

fields.label: OpenAI-compatible API
fields.help: e.g. http://vllm:8000/v1 for a vLLM service.

templates.name: vLLM
templates.description: Serve an open model from Hugging Face with an OpenAI-compatible API, on NVIDIA GPUs.
templates.author: upsetdev
hints: Needs an NVIDIA GPU server in the cluster.
The first start downloads the model to the volume: it can take many minutes.
Talk to it at http://<service>:8000/v1, like the OpenAI API.

fields.label: Model
fields.help: A Hugging Face model id. It has to fit in the GPU's memory.

templates.name: AdGuard Home
templates.description: Network-wide DNS filtering with a web admin interface.
templates.author: upsetdev
hints: DNS answers inside the cluster. Port 53 can't be a public port: the servers use it for their own lookups.
An HTTP domain can't carry DNS traffic; use the admin page's DNS-over-HTTPS address through a domain instead.

templates.name: Uptime Kuma
templates.description: Self-hosted uptime monitoring with status pages and notifications.
templates.author: upsetdev
hints: Create the admin account on first visit; add a domain before you open it.
Uses SQLite, so keep it at one replica.

templates.name: Mosquitto
templates.description: Lightweight MQTT broker for IoT and event messaging.
templates.author: upsetdev
hints: MQTT is plain TCP. Expose it through a NodePort or LoadBalancer, not an HTTP domain.

templates.name: MariaDB
templates.description: MySQL-compatible relational database with a persistent data volume.
templates.author: upsetdev
hints: Runs as a single replica; replication isn't set up.
Services in the same cluster reach it via its internal hostname.

fields.label: User password
fields.help: Leave empty to generate one. The root password is always generated.

templates.name: Grafana
templates.description: Dashboards for Prometheus and other data sources.
templates.author: upsetdev
hints: Add Prometheus as a data source using its internal hostname.

templates.name: RabbitMQ
templates.description: Message broker for queues and pub/sub, with the management web UI.
templates.author: upsetdev
hints: AMQP clients connect on 5672; the management UI is on 15672.

templates.name: CoreDNS
templates.description: Authoritative or forwarding DNS server configured with a Corefile.
templates.author: upsetdev
hints: This is separate from the cluster's own CoreDNS in kube-system.

templates.name: Meilisearch
templates.description: Typo-tolerant search engine with a simple REST API, protected by a master key.
templates.author: upsetdev
hints: Create search and admin API keys with the master key; don't ship the master key to browsers.

fields.label: Master key
fields.help: At least 16 characters. Leave empty to generate one.

templates.name: Gitea
templates.description: Lightweight Git hosting with pull requests, issues and a package registry.
templates.author: upsetdev
hints: Finish setup in the web installer on first visit; SQLite works out of the box.
Git over SSH needs a NodePort or LoadBalancer on the ssh port.

templates.name: Vaultwarden
templates.description: Bitwarden-compatible password manager server, light enough for any server.
templates.author: upsetdev
hints: Bitwarden clients need HTTPS: add a domain before you sign up.

fields.label: Allow new sign-ups
fields.help: Turn off once your accounts exist.

templates.name: ClickHouse
templates.description: Column-oriented database for fast analytics over large event tables.
templates.author: upsetdev
hints: Query over HTTP on 8123, or with clickhouse-client on 9000.
Give it memory: large queries fail when they hit the limit.

templates.name: NATS
templates.description: Lightweight, high-throughput messaging for services and edge devices.
templates.author: upsetdev
hints: Core NATS keeps messages in memory; JetStream persistence isn't enabled.

templates.name: Metabase
templates.description: Ask questions of your databases and share dashboards, no SQL required.
templates.author: upsetdev
hints: Its own settings live in an embedded H2 file on the volume.
Takes a minute or two to start the first time.

templates.name: Nginx
templates.description: Fast web server for static files, a starting point for your own image.
templates.author: upsetdev
hints: Serves the default welcome page. Build an image FROM nginx with your files to serve your site.

templates.name: Nextcloud
templates.description: Files, calendars, contacts and office documents in your own cloud, on Postgres with KV caching.
templates.author: upsetdev
hints: Needs a domain: add it before the first start, then sign in as the admin user with NEXTCLOUD_ADMIN_PASSWORD.
The first start installs Nextcloud and takes a few minutes.
Files are kept on its volume; size it for what you'll store.

templates.name: Plausible
templates.description: Lightweight, cookie-free website analytics (Community Edition), on Postgres with ClickHouse for events.
templates.author: upsetdev
hints: Needs a domain: it's BASE_URL. Register the first account there; it becomes the owner.
For password resets and reports, set MAILER_EMAIL and SMTP_HOST_ADDR, SMTP_HOST_PORT, SMTP_USER_NAME and SMTP_USER_PWD.
Events are kept by its own ClickHouse service, deployed with it.

templates.name: Umami
templates.description: Simple, privacy-focused website analytics without cookies, on a Postgres database Pyo runs.
templates.author: upsetdev
hints: Sign in as admin with the password umami, then change it right away under Settings › Profile.
Add a domain, then add your sites and their tracking script.

templates.name: Directus
templates.description: Instant REST and GraphQL APIs and a no-code admin app for a Postgres database.
templates.author: upsetdev
hints: Add a domain, then sign in with the admin email and ADMIN_PASSWORD from its variables.
Uploads are kept on its volume.

templates.name: Keycloak
templates.description: Identity and access management with single sign-on, OpenID Connect and SAML.
templates.author: upsetdev
hints: Needs a domain: it's the hostname Keycloak issues tokens for.
Sign in to the admin console with the admin user and KC_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD, then create a permanent admin; the bootstrap one is temporary.

templates.name: Mattermost
templates.description: Team chat with channels, threads, calls and integrations (Team Edition), on Postgres.
templates.author: upsetdev
hints: Needs a domain: it's the site URL. Create the first account there; it becomes the system admin.
Uploads and search indexes are kept on its volume; plugins installed later are added again on restart.

templates.name: Paperless-ngx
templates.description: Scan, OCR, index and archive your paper documents, searchable from the browser.
templates.author: upsetdev
hints: Add a domain, then sign in as the admin user with PAPERLESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD from its variables.
Documents, thumbnails and the search index are kept on its volume.
Office files and e-mail need Gotenberg and Tika: deploy them as images and set PAPERLESS_TIKA_ENABLED, PAPERLESS_TIKA_ENDPOINT and PAPERLESS_TIKA_GOTENBERG_ENDPOINT.

templates.name: Forgejo
templates.description: Lightweight, community-run Git hosting with pull requests, issues, packages and Actions.
templates.author: upsetdev
hints: Add a domain, then finish the installer there; its database is already filled in. The first account becomes the admin.
Git over SSH needs a public port for ssh (22).

templates.name: listmonk
templates.description: Newsletter and mailing list manager with campaigns, templates and analytics, on Postgres.
templates.author: upsetdev
hints: Add a domain, then sign in as the admin user with LISTMONK_ADMIN_PASSWORD from its variables.
Set the root URL and an SMTP server under Settings before sending.

templates.name: NocoDB
templates.description: Turn a Postgres database into a smart spreadsheet, with forms, views and a REST API.
templates.author: upsetdev
hints: Add a domain, then sign up there; the first account becomes the super admin.
Attachments are kept on its volume.

templates.name: Wiki.js
templates.description: Modern wiki with a visual and Markdown editor, page history and Git sync, on Postgres.
templates.author: upsetdev
hints: Add a domain, then create the admin account in the setup there.
Pages live in the database.

templates.name: BookStack
templates.description: Organize documentation into shelves, books and pages with a simple WYSIWYG editor, on MySQL.
templates.author: upsetdev
hints: Needs a domain: it's APP_URL. Sign in as admin@admin.com with the password password, then change both right away.
Uploads and settings are kept on its volume.

templates.name: LiteLLM
templates.description: One OpenAI-compatible gateway to 100+ model providers, with keys, budgets and usage tracking.
templates.author: upsetdev
hints: Sign in to the admin UI at /ui with the user admin and LITELLM_MASTER_KEY as the password; add models and keys there.
Keep LITELLM_SALT_KEY as it is; it encrypts the provider keys you save.
Other services call it at http://<service>:4000, like the OpenAI API.

templates.name: code-server
templates.description: VS Code in the browser, on your own server, with your files on a volume.
templates.author: upsetdev
hints: Add a domain, then sign in with PASSWORD from its variables.
Your projects and settings are kept in /home/coder on its volume.

fields.label: Password
fields.help: Leave empty to generate one; it's in the service's variables.

templates.name: Stirling-PDF
templates.description: Merge, split, convert, compress and sign PDFs in your browser, processed on your own server.
templates.author: upsetdev
hints: Add a domain to open it. Files are processed and then removed; nothing is kept.
Large files and OCR need memory; raise the limit if jobs fail.

templates.name: IT-Tools
templates.description: Handy tools for developers in the browser, from hashes and UUIDs to JWT and cron decoders.
templates.author: upsetdev
hints: Add a domain to open it; everything runs in the browser and nothing is stored.

templates.name: Excalidraw
templates.description: Virtual whiteboard for sketching hand-drawn-style diagrams, in the browser.
templates.author: upsetdev
hints: Drawings stay in each browser; export or save them to keep them.
Live collaboration needs Excalidraw's separate room server, which isn't included.

templates.name: ntfy
templates.description: Send push notifications to your phone or desktop with a simple HTTP request.
templates.author: upsetdev
hints: Needs a domain: the apps subscribe at its address. Publish with curl -d "hi" https://<domain>/<topic>.
Anyone can use any topic; set up users with the ntfy user command in its terminal to restrict them.

templates.name: Qdrant
templates.description: Vector database and similarity search engine for embeddings, with REST and gRPC APIs.
templates.author: upsetdev
hints: Other services reach it at http://<service>:6333 (gRPC on 6334), with the api-key header set to QDRANT__SERVICE__API_KEY.
The web UI is at /dashboard on port 6333.

templates.name: SearXNG
templates.description: Privacy-respecting metasearch engine that queries many search engines without tracking you.
templates.author: upsetdev
hints: Add a domain to open it.
Its bot limiter is off; it needs a KV database (SEARXNG_VALKEY_URL) and a settings.yml change to turn on.
